entries.original: Agents/subagents: keep session-backed parent runs active when the child wait call times out before the child session has actually settled, so late subagent completions are reconciled instead of being lost. Fixes #82787. Thanks @ramitrkar-hash.
entries.translated: Agents/subagents: keep session-backed parent runs active when the child wait call times out before the child session has actually settled, so late subagent completions are reconciled instead of being lost. Fixes #82787. Thanks @ramitrkar-hash.

entries.original: Control UI: advertise shared Gateway protocol constants in browser connect frames, fixing protocol mismatch handshakes after protocol constant drift. Fixes #82882. Thanks @galiniliev.
entries.translated: Control UI: advertise shared Gateway protocol constants in browser connect frames, fixing protocol mismatch handshakes after protocol constant drift. Fixes #82882. Thanks @galiniliev.

entries.original: Gateway: add rollback protocol-mismatch diagnostics, including client protocol ranges in Gateway logs and deep status/doctor hints for stale client processes. Fixes #82841. (#82908)
entries.translated: Gateway: add rollback protocol-mismatch diagnostics, including client protocol ranges in Gateway logs and deep status/doctor hints for stale client processes. Fixes #82841. (#82908)

entries.original: Agents/subagents: keep successful keep-mode completion payloads pending after final-delivery retry exhaustion, so requester recovery no longer loses final subagent results. Fixes #82583. (#82999) Thanks @joshavant.
entries.translated: Agents/subagents: keep successful keep-mode completion payloads pending after final-delivery retry exhaustion, so requester recovery no longer loses final subagent results. Fixes #82583. (#82999) Thanks @joshavant.

entries.original: Gateway/auth: allow same-host trusted-proxy callers to use the documented local direct `gateway.auth.password` fallback after revisiting the #78684 fail-closed policy, while keeping token fallback rejected and forwarded-header requests on the trusted-proxy path. Fixes #82607. (#82953) Thanks @joshavant.
entries.translated: Gateway/auth: allow same-host trusted-proxy callers to use the documented local direct `gateway.auth.password` fallback after revisiting the #78684 fail-closed policy, while keeping token fallback rejected and forwarded-header requests on the trusted-proxy path. Fixes #82607. (#82953) Thanks @joshavant.

entries.original: Agents/subagents: wait for queued completion handoffs to reach the parent transcript before marking them announced, preventing busy parent runs from cleaning up before observing child results. Fixes #82913. (#83039) Thanks @joshavant.
entries.translated: Agents/subagents: wait for queued completion handoffs to reach the parent transcript before marking them announced, preventing busy parent runs from cleaning up before observing child results. Fixes #82913. (#83039) Thanks @joshavant.

entries.original: Agents/subagents: route group/channel subagent completions through message-tool-only handoffs when required and keep active-requester wake failures from dropping completion delivery. Fixes #82803. Thanks @galiniliev, @yozakura-ava, and @moeedahmed.
entries.translated: Agents/subagents: route group/channel subagent completions through message-tool-only handoffs when required and keep active-requester wake failures from dropping completion delivery. Fixes #82803. Thanks @galiniliev, @yozakura-ava, and @moeedahmed.

entries.original: Memory-core: scan persisted memory source sessions on startup, comparing on-disk transcripts against the index and marking only missing/newer/resized files dirty for incremental sync. Fixes #82341. (#82341) Thanks @giodl73-repo.
entries.translated: Memory-core: scan persisted memory source sessions on startup, comparing on-disk transcripts against the index and marking only missing/newer/resized files dirty for incremental sync. Fixes #82341. (#82341) Thanks @giodl73-repo.

entries.original: Telegram: keep the top-level default account in the account list when named accounts or bindings are added alongside top-level credentials, preserving default polling while still letting named-only configs resolve to a single account. Fixes #82794. (#82794) Thanks @giodl73-repo.
entries.translated: Telegram: keep the top-level default account in the account list when named accounts or bindings are added alongside top-level credentials, preserving default polling while still letting named-only configs resolve to a single account. Fixes #82794. (#82794) Thanks @giodl73-repo.

entries.original: CLI/models: reuse command-scoped plugin metadata across model listing, provider catalog, auth, and synthetic-auth checks, restoring fast `openclaw models` runs for plugin-heavy installs. Fixes #82881. (#83033) Thanks @joshavant.
entries.translated: CLI/models: reuse command-scoped plugin metadata across model listing, provider catalog, auth, and synthetic-auth checks, restoring fast `openclaw models` runs for plugin-heavy installs. Fixes #82881. (#83033) Thanks @joshavant.

entries.original: CLI/channels: show configured official external channels such as Discord in `openclaw channels list` when their plugin package is missing, including the install and doctor repair command instead of reporting no configured channels. Fixes #82813.
entries.translated: CLI/channels: show configured official external channels such as Discord in `openclaw channels list` when their plugin package is missing, including the install and doctor repair command instead of reporting no configured channels. Fixes #82813.

entries.original: Signal: preserve mixed-case group IDs through routing and session persistence so group auto-replies keep delivering after updates. Fixes #82827.
entries.translated: Signal: preserve mixed-case group IDs through routing and session persistence so group auto-replies keep delivering after updates. Fixes #82827.

entries.original: Agents/tools: keep the `message` tool available in embedded runs when it is explicitly allowed through `tools.alsoAllow` or runtime tool allowlists, so channel plugins with custom reply delivery can still use configured message sends. Fixes #82833. Thanks @cn1313113.
entries.translated: Agents/tools: keep the `message` tool available in embedded runs when it is explicitly allowed through `tools.alsoAllow` or runtime tool allowlists, so channel plugins with custom reply delivery can still use configured message sends. Fixes #82833. Thanks @cn1313113.

entries.original: WhatsApp: honor forced document delivery for outbound image, GIF, and video media so `forceDocument`/`asDocument` sends preserve original media bytes instead of using compressed media payloads. (#79272) Thanks @itsuzef.
entries.translated: WhatsApp: honor forced document delivery for outbound image, GIF, and video media so `forceDocument`/`asDocument` sends preserve original media bytes instead of using compressed media payloads. (#79272) Thanks @itsuzef.

entries.original: WhatsApp: name outbound document attachments from their MIME type when no filename is provided, so PDF and CSV sends arrive as `file.pdf` and `file.csv` instead of an extensionless `file`. Thanks @mcaxtr.
entries.translated: WhatsApp: name outbound document attachments from their MIME type when no filename is provided, so PDF and CSV sends arrive as `file.pdf` and `file.csv` instead of an extensionless `file`. Thanks @mcaxtr.

entries.original: Process/diagnostics: report active lane blockers in lane wait warnings so `queueAhead=0` no longer hides commands waiting behind active work. Fixes #82791. (#82792) Thanks @galiniliev.
entries.translated: Process/diagnostics: report active lane blockers in lane wait warnings so `queueAhead=0` no longer hides commands waiting behind active work. Fixes #82791. (#82792) Thanks @galiniliev.

entries.translated: Process/diagnostics: stop counting the active processing turn as queued backlog in liveness warnings so transient max-only event-loop spikes do not surface as gateway warnings.

entries.original: Agents/replies: classify provider conversation-state rejections and return a clear message-channel error instead of auto-resetting or falling back to a generic runner failure. (#82616) Thanks @dutifulbob.
entries.translated: Agents/replies: classify provider conversation-state rejections and return a clear message-channel error instead of auto-resetting or falling back to a generic runner failure. (#82616) Thanks @dutifulbob.
